edits: add F at positions 2,3,6,7 of the biphenyl rings
proposals.hypothesis: D15 has the strongest binding (-27.9) with no detachment, but its margin is -0.196. Two distal F (previous round) lifted the margin by about 0.11 and cost only about 1.2 kcal of binding (f 1.02). Following that promoted direction, four distal F should lift the margin by roughly 0.2 more, reaching 0.15 or higher, while the o-quinone binding mode stays intact. K117 and K084 report CO2 adducts for o-quinone and F-quinone. Avoided: CN (detached), NH2/OH (lowered f). Risk: F on the dione ring is not used; margin gain may saturate.

edits: add Cl at positions 3 and 6 of the biphenyl rings
proposals.hypothesis: Ring Cl raised margin in D13 over D12 (+0.28). Cl at the 3,6 positions, para to the biaryl bond and meta to the carbonyl-bearing carbon, is a different electronic placement from the tested 2,7 pattern, and should lift the margin from -0.196 while keeping most of D15's strong binding (-27.9, f 1.09). K019 shows chlorinated quinones still bind CO2. Avoided CN and NH2/OH. Risk: margin may stay under 0.15.

edits: move Cl from ring position 6 to position 5 (2,5-dichloro)
proposals.hypothesis: D07 (2,6-Cl2) has the best f (1.24) but a margin of only 0.097. Moving a Cl to the 2,5 pattern changes the dipole and the carbonyl electron density without adding halogen bulk, which cost binding in D14 and D11. K020 reports strong CO2 binding for a dichloro-BQ (K = 8.2e5). The hope is a margin gain of 0.05 or more while holding f near D07. Risk: f gain beyond 2 is unlikely from one isomer move.

edits: add Cl at ring position 5 and F at position 2 relative to H-bearing carbon, giving 2,3-dichloro-5-fluoro-BQ
proposals.hypothesis: D07 gains margin with each halogen (D08, D14) but loses binding with heavy halogens (D14 f 0.72). A trihalo BQ with one small F and two Cl, keeping one open C-H, limits steric crowding around the carbonyls that weakened binding. D08 (F4) kept bind -24.3, and K084 shows F-BQ adducts. Expected margin around 0.2 with binding near -24. Risk: f may stay around 1.

edits: add F at positions 1 and 8, adjacent to the dione-bearing carbons
proposals.hypothesis: Distal F far from the dione raised the D15 margin only partly. Placing F ortho to the dione-bearing carbons puts the inductive effect nearer the carbonyls, which should raise the reduction potential and margin more per F, as the dione-ring halogens did in D13 (+0.28). D15's binding of -27.9 gives headroom for some loss. Avoided CN, NH2 and OH. Risk: F near the carbonyls may disturb the CO2 adduct geometry and lower f.

structured_output.reason: Five new halogen-only proposals. They promote the directions that raised f or margin without a large binding loss (F or Cl on D15, mixed small halogens on D07). They avoid CN, NH2 and OH, which detached CO2 or lowered f.
